title: Faithful Imprints 64x
description: Faithful 64x imprint textures for the Soft Imprints mod
body:
![Sheep](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1c11fce14e0902e88226b900be233d5bd6f9e519.webp) ## About A resource pack for the **Soft Imprints** mod that provides imprint textures in the Faithful 64x style.
There are **Sand**, **Red Sand**, and **Snow** imprints here. ## Requirements - [Soft Imprints](https://modrinth.com/mod/snow-imprints) - [Faithful 64x](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/faithful-64x) (optional) ## Credits - Faithful: https://faithfulpack.net/ - Imprint Textures are licensed under the [Faithful License](https://faithfulpack.net/license) ## More screenshots
In-game view and Config Screen ![Settings x64](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2e2c5ff02ad5f1f5b587321cd105872eafcf617.webp) ![Camel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/064344c80604070f3344ee6a81d620fe8b8b6767.webp)
